RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: canteen
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Where inmates eat during meal times. Needs tables, chairs and food (cooks put meals here: place a stockpile or serving counter in the canteen).

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: yard
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Outdoor free-time area inside the perimeter. Inmates spend free time here: fresh air, recreation, socializing.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: common room
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Indoor free-time area with recreation. Used for free time when there is no yard, or alongside it.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: showers
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Shower block. Inmates wash here during shower time.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: holding
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Where guards walk new inmates from the state shuttle, to wait for a search before they are sent to their cells.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: kitchen
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Staff-only cooking area. Inmates cannot enter.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: staff room
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Where staff on site take their shift breaks: somewhere to sit (any seat; a table to sit at is better), a cup of tea, a chat away from the wings. Staff come back from a break here in better spirits, the more so the better the room (impressiveness). Inmates cannot enter.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: morgue
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Staff-only room where the prison's dead are put. Guards, cooks, workmen and janitors carry the body of an inmate or a staff member here, instead of leaving it where it fell to rot in front of everybody. Inmates cannot enter.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: burial plot
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: A staff-only patch of bare ground (soil, not a floor) where the prison buries the dead nobody will send for. Workmen carry the body of an inmate with no family in touch, or of a member of staff with none, here from the morgue and dig a grave (each takes two cells). With no plot, a body with no family goes home on the state shuttle with the others and nobody writes about it. The dead who have a family always go home on the shuttle, and the family writes to the warden. Inmates cannot enter.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: hearing room
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Where the parole board sits. Needs an office desk (the board's) and at least one chair for the inmate. With one, inmates who are due a hearing are called here between 9:00 and 17:00, walked in by a guard, and sit before the board (an administrator if there is one, else the warden's chair); the board decides on what is in their file and who speaks for or against them, and the decision letter lists them. Every chair is one hearing an hour; the rest are decided by the board at midnight. Without a hearing room the board decides at midnight, unseen.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: staff only
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Offices, staff rooms, storage, armoury. Inmates cannot enter; doors into it are staff-only for them.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: deliveries
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Where the state shuttle's crew sets down the supplies it brings, instead of on the pad. Keep it outside the perimeter, near the shuttle pad.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: exports
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Goods left here (prison industry output) are loaded on the state shuttle before it lifts off, and sold. Keep it near the shuttle pad.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: minimum security wing
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Paint over cells: their beds take only minimum security inmates.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: medium security wing
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Paint over cells: their beds take only medium security inmates.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: maximum security wing
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Paint over cells: their beds take only maximum security inmates.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: protective custody wing
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Paint over cells: their beds take only inmates in protective custody.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: death row wing
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Paint over cells: their beds take only death row inmates. Death row inmates are only housed here.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: supermax security wing
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: Paint over cells: their beds take only supermax inmates, who leave them only with a guard. A cell with more than one bed takes none. Paint the shower room of the wing with it too (supermax inmates are walked to a shower that has no one else in it, the wing's own before any other), and give it a supermax yard.

RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.label: supermax yard
RimPrison.PrisonZoneDef.description: A small yard of the supermax wing, at least four cells. A guard walks one supermax inmate out to it for their hour alone; no one else's free time ever goes here, and the hour is skipped while another inmate is in the patch. Wall it off from everything else: the doors of the wing open to an inmate only on the guard's walk, but a yard that opens on the general yard would not be alone. Several inmates need several patches or the hours of the regime: a message at midnight names who missed the yard.
